x: The race was won by Kenya's Benson Masya in an astounding 60:24 and only 16 men from the UK featured in the first 100. Paul's time was only four seconds outside his pb set in Lisbon over a course thought to be 50 metres short so he felt pretty pleased with his effort.
Miano was in trouble, Benson Masya dropped off and then Stephan Franke (4th placer in the World Champs 10k) was well adrift as '5' was reached in 22:57 and '6' in 27:32.

Superb running - but those Kenyans are something else again, sprinting for the line after almost exactly one hour's running and needing TV video replays to determine the actual winner. 1, B.Masya (Ken) 60:02; 2, M.Tanui (Ken) 60.03; 3, P.Tergat (Ken) 60:42; 4, P.Evans (Bel) 61:30.
